<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="18" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="330" y1="14" x2="334" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="12" x2="341" y2="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="10" x2="348" y2="10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="358" cy="13" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="354" y1="13" x2="362" y2="13" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="371" y="7" width="17" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="373" y="9" width="12" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="389" y="10" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- top navigation -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="30,60 21,69 30,78" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="22" y1="69" x2="42" y2="69" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="73" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">ACCOUNT ACCESS</text>
    <line x1="20" y1="94" x2="370" y2="94" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- form content -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="145" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="32" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">My email is</text>
    <text x="24" y="174" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Enter your email to verify your account</text>
    <text x="24" y="202" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">EMAIL ADDRESS</text>

    <rect x="20" y="214" width="350" height="56" rx="10" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="36" y="248" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">alex.morgan@example.com</text>
    <circle cx="344" cy="242" r="10" fill="#96E063"/>
    <polyline points="339,242 343,246 350,238" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

    <text x="24" y="291" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">We'll send a verification link to this address.</text>
    <text x="24" y="309" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">Your email stays private and secure.</text>

    <g filter="url(#shadow)">
      <rect x="90" y="342" width="210" height="44" rx="62" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    </g>
    <text x="195" y="369" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="72" y="402" width="246" height="42" rx="21" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="195" y="428" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">USE A DIFFERENT EMAIL</text>
    </g>

    <text x="195" y="468" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">By continuing, you agree to our Terms and Privacy Policy.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- keyboard -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="490" width="390" height="354" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="0" y="490" width="390" height="34" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
    <polyline points="24,507 30,501 36,507" fill="none" stroke="#7D8490" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="53" y="512" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#7D8490">Show QuickType</text>
    <circle cx="365" cy="507" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="361" y1="507" x2="369" y2="507" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="365" y1="503" x2="365" y2="511" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>

      <rect x="244" y="532" width="35" height="43" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/><text x="261.5" y="560">U</text>
      <rect x="284" y="532" width="35" height="43" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/><text x="301.5" y="560">I</text>
      <rect x="324" y="532" width="35" height="43" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/><text x="341.5" y="560">O</text>
      <rect x="364" y="532" width="22" height="43" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/><text x="375" y="560">P</text>

    <!-- keyboard row 2 -->
    <g font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000000">

      <rect x="64" y="581" width="35" height="43" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/><text x="81.5" y="609">S</text>

      <rect x="264" y="581" width="35" height="43" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/><text x="281.5" y="609">J</text>
      <rect x="304" y="581" width="35" height="43" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/><text x="321.5" y="609">K</text>
      <rect x="344" y="581" width="35" height="43" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/><text x="361.5" y="609">L</text>

    <!-- keyboard row 3 -->

      <rect x="92" y="630" width="35" height="43" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/><text x="109.5" y="658">X</text>
      <rect x="132" y="630" width="35" height="43" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/><text x="149.5" y="658">C</text>

      <rect x="212" y="630" width="35" height="43" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/><text x="229.5" y="658">B</text>
      <rect x="252" y="630" width="35" height="43" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/><text x="269.5" y="658">N</text>
      <rect x="292" y="630" width="35" height="43" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/><text x="309.5" y="658">M</text>
      <rect x="332" y="630" width="54" height="43" rx="5" fill="#D0CECD"/>

      <line x1="363" y1="643" x2="363" y2="660" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>

    <!-- keyboard row 4 -->
    <g font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000000">
      <rect x="4" y="679" width="43" height="43" rx="5" fill="#D0CECD"/><text x="25.5" y="706">123</text>
      <rect x="52" y="679" width="43" height="43" rx="5" fill="#D0CECD"><circle cx="73.5" cy="701" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/><text x="73.5" y="705">#</text></rect>
      <rect x="100" y="679" width="190" height="43" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/><text x="195" y="706">space</text>
      <rect x="295" y="679" width="91" height="43" rx="5" fill="#4396F7"/><text x="340.5" y="706" fill="#FFFFFF">return</text>
    </g>

    <!-- keyboard footer -->
    <line x1="0" y1="731" x2="390" y2="731" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="816" r="14" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="135" y="812" width="120" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="22" y="753" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#7D8490">English (US)</text>
    <text x="368" y="753" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#7D8490">Done</text>
  </g>
</svg>
